{"id":"AFT-7","uuid":"5c84ce9d-1068-4407-ab19-9d822bb94dc1","title":"Complete the guided first-session journey","description":"Planning key: B-07
Milestone: S1 — First use
Requirements: R-01, R-02
Canonical specification: product/backlog.md (B-07) in <developer-home>/after-effects-studio.

* Priority: High. Dependencies: B-05, B-06.
* Scope: implement the install → connect → inspect → brief → editable scene → inspected preview → meaningful revision path in an explicitly owned scene.
* Acceptance: documented instructions carry a fresh task through the entire journey; required permissions and missing information are surfaced at the right step; no private repo, rig or paid media service is required; project inspection precedes writes.
* Evidence: quality/reports/YYYY-MM-DD-first-session/ with exact prompt/actions, outputs and failures. This local run does not replace B-18.

Completion requires a concrete outcome and evidence. Record source revision, package version/hash, host, actions, checks, failures and output paths for executed quality work. Native checks require exact-project inspection, one AE controller and preservation of unrelated work. Runtime success, visual review and user acceptance are separate.

2026-10-06 controlled source-MCP run: doctor and live read-only connection passed on macOS 26.6.2 / AE 26.5x89 / Node 25.9.0. Exact project was unsaved and empty. Created one named 44-layer native comp, rendered and inspected six before frames, revised title/subtitle by stable layer IDs without duplication, rendered and inspected six after frames, then removed only the verified owned comp and confirmed zero items. Creator guide: plugin/docs/first-session.md. Evidence: quality/reports/2026-10-06-first-session/native-journey.md and ignored quality/renders/2026-10-06-first-session/. A post-render read-only query stalled about 47s but completed; no write was retried. Still open: a fresh installed Codex task following the guide. No full movie/AEP, clean-machine run or user taste acceptance claimed.

2026-10-07 app-reopen check: Joe restarted Codex. The personal marketplace shows after-effects-studio@personal installed/enabled at 0.1.0+codex.20261007055008, and this existing task sees skills from that exact cache. Its callable tool inventory still lacks the plugin's MCP namespace. The installed cache's doctor passed; a direct read-only MCP launch from the installed cache successfully returned AE 26.5x89 and project context. AE currently has a separate saved, dirty 89-item project open; no write/switch/save/close was attempted. This is partial refresh evidence, not the guided journey in a fresh installed task. Report: quality/reports/2026-10-07-app-reopen/report.md. Keep In Progress.

2026-10-07 fresh Codex chat check: BLOCKED at installed plugin MCP attachment. This genuinely new chat sees the skills from 0.1.0+codex.20261007055008, but its callable inventory contains only the separate Higgsfield AE controller, not After Effects Studio MCP tools. No Higgsfield/native call or manual MCP client was used. Exact installed manifest verified; installed doctor passes on macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), arm64, Node 25.9.0. Installed-tree SHA-256 (450 files; method and per-file hashes in evidence): a42b0d9e8328e9878d52a3bd22b2760623ceb6e9bcc6699f99f808be7f1d1483. Desktop host bundle: ChatGPT 26.928.40906 (12694), with Codex framework process paths. AE bundle metadata is 26.5.0.89; live AE version and Joe's reported fresh project could not be verified through required ae_version_info/ae_context. No native scene, preview, revision, save, switch, close or cleanup occurred. No visual, pacing, permissions or creative acceptance claimed. Report: quality/reports/2026-10-07-fresh-task-first-session/report.md; raw inventory, hashes, doctor and host evidence: quality/reports/raw/2026-10-07-fresh-task-first-session/. Keep In Progress. Next: resolve installed plugin MCP attachment in Codex, then repeat Q-01 beginning with exact current-project inspection. Fresh-chat evidence rules out explaining this result solely as reuse of the previous chat; root cause remains undiagnosed.

2026-10-07 fresh installed task acceptance: PASS for the scoped local first-session journey, with a documented color-easing workaround. Candidate 0.1.0+codex.20261007193805 attached its own MCP tools in this new chat. codex mcp get resolves the installed cache, and installed doctor passes from /tmp. Live AE 26.5x89 reported an untitled, dirty, empty project before writes. Built comp AFT7_INSTALLED_1945_ALIGNMENT (ID 25), 1920x1080/30fps/5s with nine editable native layers. Rendered and visually inspected six before and six after samples plus full-size holds. Changed headline by stable layer ID 39 and final accent color by ID 43. Complete project JSON comparison confirms only headline, final color-key RGB and export timestamp changed; same comp/layer IDs and all other structure/timing retained. Final project remains unsaved, with just the owned comp open at 4.5s. No Higgsfield, manual MCP client, private rig/repo, external asset service, save/close/switch/clear or duplicate comp. Installed-tree fingerprint (450 files): f390e6c46bd155aee8f6661b755a548cc70af73ba405077d68cc21207c24e206.

Warning retained: keyframe.apply on a COLOR property emitted setTemporalEaseAtKey array-size warnings; readback found linear color keys, and an explicit linear reapply succeeded. This runtime color-easing defect remains a follow-up; the scoped journey succeeded with that workaround. No warning-free original build claimed. Installation was performed by the preceding task; this chat verified the resulting installed artifact and completed the fresh-task continuation.

Report: quality/reports/2026-10-07-installed-first-session-1945/report.md; complete tool/host/hash/diff evidence alongside it. Renders and project JSON: quality/renders/2026-10-07-installed-first-session-1945/.
